name: pi-voice-telegram-scripts
description: Runtime shell scripts for the pi-voice-telegram stack. The Pi agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge call these from telegram.json#outboundHandlers[0].template to synthesize voice replies. Pure Node.js / bash, no build step. The two .mjs files are the canonical TTS clients (one per provider); the .ts file is the OpenAI-compatible shim for the local whisper-server. After `npm install`, all three are available on PATH as `tts-minimax`, `tts-openai`, and `fw-openai-sts` (via the bin field).
